goblinoid.name: Greenskins and Goblinoids
goblinoid.description: Feral, swarming underground vermin that strike from shadow with poisoned blades.

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: Restless souls bound by fell sorcery, haunting ancient tombs and forgotten ruins.

aquatic.name: Scaled and Aquatic
aquatic.description: Cold-blooded predators of the deep caves and dark swamps, masters of scale and tooth.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.description: Living manifestations of primal forces, born of glacier or inferno.

ancient.name: Ancient
ancient.description: Primordial guardians of the earth, older than memory and rooted in ancient magic.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.description: Brutish mountain-dwellers with raw strength and limited cunning.

giant.name: Mythic and Giants
giant.description: Colossi that shake the mountains themselves, born of ancient stone and deep hunger.

demon.name: Demon
demon.description: Malicious horrors from infernal planes that warp reality with their mere presence.

misc.name: Misc
misc.description: Entities that defy standard classification, from magical constructs to simple training dummies.
